title: Ext comparison for the derived-unit pullback on global cohomology
statement: Let $X,X'$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g':X'\to X$ a morphism, $G$ an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Write $K=G[0]$ in the bounded below derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $P=R\Gamma(X,-)$ and $P'=R\Gamma(X',-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Let $U=H^q(PK)$ and $V=H^q(P'(g'^{-1}K))$, where $g'^{-1}$ is the exact derived inverse image [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. Let $\eta_K:K\to Rg'_*g'^{-1}K$ be the derived adjunction unit [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], and $\lambda:P(Rg'_*L)\xrightarrow{\sim}P'L$ the Leray isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit]. Put $p=H^q(P(\eta_K)\,;\,\lambda_{g'^{-1}K}):U\to V$. There exist additive equivalences $b_1:U\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{Sheaf.H}(G,q)$ and $b_2:V\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{Sheaf.H}(g'^{-1}G,q)$, with Sheaf.H the Ext cohomology convention [lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison], such that $b_2(p(x))=\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g',G,q)(b_1(x))$ for every $x\in U$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

source.place: Definition of cohomology by derived global sections; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08J6 (Leray); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F8 and equations 01F9, 01FA (unit construction of pullback), specialized to abelian etale sheaves and Ext from the constant integers.

proof.text: Choose injective resolutions I of G and J of its inverse image. Exactness of inverse image makes g prime inverse image of I a resolution; comparison into J is unique up to homotopy.

Use the constant integer sheaf adjunction termwise to identify Hom(Z,I) with global sections of I, and similarly for J. Compute Ext by these resolutions and the homology of derived global sections by the same complexes. These give b1 and b2, including degree zero.

The mapExactFunctor formula in cohomologyMap applies exact inverse image to a cocycle and precomposes the constant-sheaf comparison. Under evaluation at 1 this is the unit section map followed by the comparison to J. The derived-unit and Leray formula identifies that complex map with p. Homology therefore gives the required compatibility. This verifies compatibility of the two particular resolution comparisons, not of arbitrary additive isomorphisms.
